pinterest.description: You should not need to keep the whole AI workflow in your head just to trust it. Fluent wording can hide weak facts, private information or missing permissions. Time saved at generation can disappear in supervision and correction. An AI-assisted email still needs the facts, recipient and approval checked once before sending.
